stemMd: A researcher introduces a small water-soluble dye into one animal cell. It passes directly into neighbouring cells through channels joining their cytoplasms. Which junction is implicated?
explanationMd: Gap junction channels connect adjacent animal-cell cytoplasms and allow small molecules or ions to pass. Tight junctions seal and desmosomes anchor, so their functions do not match the observed transfer.

distractorRationale.c: Tight junctions seal spaces rather than provide cytoplasmic channels.
distractorRationale.b: A plasmid is DNA, not an animal cell junction.
distractorRationale.d: This separates nucleus and cytoplasm within one cell.
